Tenants.description: Configures the management of the tenants from the admin and the tenant API. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Tenants/.

TenantRemovalAllowed.description: Whether a tenant can be removed when it is not set up yet or is disabled.

RequireTablePrefix.description: Whether a non-empty table prefix is required when a tenant is created, or an uninitialized tenant is edited, with a database provider that supports table prefixes. Useful when tenants share the same database.

TablePrefixPattern.description: A Fluid template used to generate the table prefix of each tenant instead of entering it manually, rendered with 'ShellSettings' in scope, e.g. '{{ ShellSettings.Name }}'. The result must be a valid SQL identifier.

SchemaPattern.description: A Fluid template used to generate the database schema of each tenant instead of entering it manually, rendered with 'ShellSettings' in scope, e.g. 'dbo' or '{{ ShellSettings.Name }}'. The result must be a valid SQL identifier.

OrchardCore_Tenants.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Tenants' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Tenants' instead.
